name: hawkeye-ai-bridge
description: Fast local code and asset search for large codebases, Unity and Unreal projects. Engine agnostic. Bridges the Hawkeye desktop search app to Claude using ~85-91% fewer tokens than grep-style search.

hawkeye_path.title: Hawkeye executable
hawkeye_path.description: Full path to hawkeye.exe. Change this only if Hawkeye is not installed in C:\Program Files\Hawkeye.
